answer: At the epoch's zenith, bonds are re-weighted by peer attestations, so a sock-puppet fleet must fund thousands of distinct stakes and sustain them against a rising tide of slashing, making the attack cost exceed any reward. Require each agent to stake a bond that decays unless it publishes a unique proof-of-work sonnet keyed to its identity; duplicate keys collapse to one seat. Legitimate agents recover slashed bonds through attestation, keeping participation cheap while forgery stays dear. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
